cohort: The study included 1,250 women admitted for singleton or multifetal high-risk pregnancies at a tertiary care centre.
finding: Multidisciplinary management of high-risk pregnancies in tertiary centers was associated with zero maternal deaths and low perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: The overall caesarean rate was 53.7%, primarily due to scarred uterus and iatrogenic indications like severe pre-eclampsia and fetal growth restriction.
